column1: #font arial.ttf, segoeui.ttf, tahoma.ttf, ArabicTypesetting.ttf, GeezaPro.ttc, NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf, truetype/noto/NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf
# Arabic needs two things the bundled faces cannot give it.
# The first is glyphs, and the line above names faces that have them; every one
# of those ships with a stock install of the platform it belongs to.
# The second is SHAPING. An Arabic letter has a different form at the start,
# middle and end of a word, and joining them is HarfBuzz's job -- which SDL_ttf
# only does when it was built against it. This build reports whether it could
# honour the direction at all, and the settings page says so plainly rather
# than drawing unjoined letters backwards and calling it Arabic.
